frontage component.description: A component: its own owner, so its effects die with it.

frontage signal.description: A value that remembers who read it.

frontage memo.description: A derived value, recomputed only when its inputs changed.

frontage effect.description: Runs after render, and again when its dependencies change.

frontage show.description: One branch or the other, built lazily.

frontage for.description: A list by identity: a reorder moves nodes instead of rebuilding them.

frontage switch.description: The first Match whose condition holds.

frontage resource.description: An async read tied to its inputs; hydrates by creation order.

frontage action.description: An async write, with pending and error state you can render.

frontage loading boundary.description: Show a fallback while the resources under it are unresolved.

frontage errored boundary.description: Catch errors raised under it and render a fallback.

frontage state.description: A class whose fields are signals and whose computed values are memos.

frontage store.description: A deep reactive wrapper over dicts and lists.

frontage mount.description: Attach a view to a DOM node.

frontage template.description: A view from a template string.
